why: Proposal A delivers every named piece in the requested black and dark-wood palette: a dark brown-black desk, a black mesh chair, a low bookcase, a black lamp and a leather lounge chair for reading. Its dark finishes echo the dark floor and contrast with the white walls. In Proposal B, the grey-brown desk and the lamp with a light wood accent are only acceptable. The black vinyl reception armchair is not a small leather reading chair and looks like office waiting-room furniture, so it clashes with the study look.
